annotations.title: Read recorded demand for exact sealed contents

description: Read cached exact Commander contents with USD Full EV contributions and source-recorded TCGplayer units. Resolve a numeric product ID with spellbook_sealed_product_search. Returns exact printing/finish, quantities, child membership, baseline 100-unit categories, compatible source-date windows, coverage, revisions, expiry, missingFields and limitations. An EV-weighted mean30d uses only value with a complete compatible 30-date observation. Partial and 29-date observations remain labeled. Market units are source-relative observations, not personal sell time. Returns no purchase verdict or ranking.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

limit.description: Contributor rows per response, default20, maximum100. Whole-product EV and coverage denominators remain unchanged.

offset.description: Contributor offset, starting at zero. Follow nextOffset to inspect every contributor.

revision.description: Publication revision from a prior page. A changed revision requires restarting at offset0.

tcgProductId.description: Exact numeric Commander deck or case product ID.

name: spellbook_contents_demand
